metadata.description: One PoC signer: the runner in one confidential container group, plus the network entry container that deploy.sh render adds from network/<NETWORK>.json (an optional overlay; this tree has none). The runner does the attestation and the key release itself, in process; no other container in the group listens on a port. Its command holds only the flags that are the same for every signer; the signer's values come in its setup (signerSetup, base64 of the binary setup, into SIGNER_SETUP). deploy.sh render fills the capitalised placeholders between two at signs per signer; do not deploy this file as it is. signerSetup and the network part's parameters have no default on purpose: az confcom turns such a parameter into a wildcard rule, so their values stay out of the CCE policy hash.
Base64 of the signer's binary setup (runner/cmd/setup-tool encode). Not secret. No default: wildcard in the CCE policy, so one policy serves every signer.
